text:
Asha Rao: Victor sent a follow-up asking for a compact evidence pack showing RBAC changes tied to KMS activity for Oct-Dec 2023. They want a single example end-to-end plus CSV mapping. Who can assemble and redact?

Tom Nguyen: I can handle the queries. Plan: 1) git history for infra/roles, 2) k8s audit slices for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding, 3) CloudTrail KMS events (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Encrypt). I will produce one anchor example and the bulk CSV.

Riley Ortiz: Note we need to preserve chain-of-custody: ephemeral host used, sha256 of artifacts, and provenance in manifest. Also confirm retention retrieval time for older logs (some require Glacier restore).

Marta Gomez: Redaction policy: replace human emails with deterministic sha256(email) and mark service principals as full ARNs unless requested. We'll include a redaction-key file available only to the engagement lead. Auditor ok?

Victor (External Auditor): Redactions acceptable if mapping is available to the engagement lead under NDA. Also include how you validated timestamps across systems. A single concrete correlation example is sufficient.

Tom Nguyen: Sample AWS CLI pipeline I'll run (saved in manifest):
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z --max-results 50 > raw_kms_decrypts.json
jq -r '.Events[] | .CloudTrailEvent | fromjson | select(.eventName=="Decrypt") | {time:.eventTime, arn:.userIdentity.arn, keyId:.requestParameters.keyId, requestId:.requestID}' raw_kms_decrypts.json > kms_decrypts_filtered.json

Tom Nguyen: Sample k8s audit extraction (we'll run against s3 archive):
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-log-archive/k8s-audit/2023/2023-11-*.json.gz - | zcat | jq -c 'select(.objectRef.resource=="rolebindings" or .objectRef.resource=="clusterrolebindings") | select(.verb=="create" or .verb=="patch") | {time:.stageTimestamp, user:.user.username, obj:.objectRef}' > k8s_rbac_events_ndjson

Riley Ortiz: For git: git log --pretty=format:'%H %cd %s' --since=2023-10-01 --until=2023-12-31 infra/iam | grep -i role
We'll attach commit ids and PR numbers.

Asha Rao: Tom, please ensure your queries include AWS account IDs and key ARNs so we can align to our KMS keys. Also add a CSV column for time_offset_warning if any event source has skews >5s.

Tom Nguyen: Will do. For time sync validation: we'll include NTP config from bastion (ntpq -p), kubelet times (journalctl --since), and note AWS events are in UTC. Documented in manifest.

Marta Gomez: I'll create the packaging script that: 1) runs the queries on an ephemeral bastion, 2) gzips outputs, 3) computes sha256sums, and 4) uploads to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/2023-q4/rbac-kms-evidence/<run-id>/. Script will include aws-cli/jq/kubectl versions.

Tom Nguyen: One concrete anchor example I plan to include: commit abcdef123 -> PR #546 merged role-binding-change.yaml on 2023-11-18T12:03:22Z -> k8s RoleBinding patch observed 2023-11-18T12:04:02Z by user system:serviceaccount:prod:ingress-sa -> CloudTrail Decrypt by assumed role arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ingress-role/ingress-sa at 2023-11-18T12:04:07Z (requestId: 1111-2222). We'll show mapping principal ARN -> internal svc account in CSV.

Victor (External Auditor): That anchor example looks good. Please include the raw event snippets (redacted as discussed) and the manifest describing commands and checksums. Also mark which artifacts are redacted.

Riley Ortiz: I'll request a temporary role for Tom to fetch the CloudTrail buckets. Tom, need s3:GetObject on s3://redwood-log-archive/cloudtrail/2023/*

Asha Rao: Created temporary role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/tom-audit-run for 3 hours. Posting policy in internal ticket.

Tom Nguyen: Thanks, I ran exports and uploaded: kms_decrypts_filtered.json.gz (redacted), k8s_rbac_events_2023Q4.ndjson.gz (excerpts), git_iam_commits_2023Q4.csv, principal_mapping_2023Q4.csv, manifest.txt, checksums.txt. Uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/2023-q4/rbac-kms-evidence/20231118-run-id-7/

Marta Gomez: Verified checksums and added sha256 files. Manifest includes runtime host fingerprint and tool versions. Redaction-key stored in internal vault path secret/audit/redaction/2023-q4 (accessible to engagement lead).

Victor (External Auditor): Received and reviewed anchor example. All good. One follow-up: can you include CSV column for evidence_path and redaction_status?

Asha Rao: Added columns and re-uploaded updated CSVs. Closing this thread 44d

Tom Nguyen: Thanks team. If auditor asks for deltas or further drill-down I'll reopen.
